researcher_notes:
Scope: DFW, Austin and San Antonio only - every Houston-area hit was pushed to `rejected` for the Houston segment. Sources swept: ExaSearch/ExaContents/ExaResearch across Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, Paylocity, JobTarget, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn Jobs and Built In for live EA postings; law.com Texas Lawyer, Texas Lawbook, Androvett, GlobeNewswire/BusinessWire and firm sites for boutique-firm launches and partner moves; the SEC adviserinfo.sec.gov firm-search API plus Form ADV Part 2A brochure PDFs (pdftotext) for RIA/PE/family-office phones, addresses and control changes; Inc. 5000 2025 and 2026 press releases, Dallas Innovates, D CEO, Fort Worth Business Press and Fort Worth Report for growth lists; Becker's Spine, Community Impact, PRWeb/PR Newswire and practice websites for physician-owned practices; Fitt Insider, Built In Austin and Fierce Healthcare for health-tech funding. All phones and emails below were pulled by direct curl of the official page (or the Form ADV cover page) and grepped, including Cloudflare-obfuscated mailto decoding - none were pattern-guessed.

What was thin: (1) Live EA postings from Texas-HQ companies in the 5-150 band are genuinely scarce - most DFW/Austin/SA EA-to-CEO ads either come from staffing agencies that hide the client, or from employers well above 150 employees. That is why the hiring_ea bucket lands at 7 rather than 10; the near-misses are all itemised in `rejected` with the disqualifying reason. (2) San Antonio and Austin boutique law firms very rarely publish attorney emails - I probed ~25 firms (Santoyo Wehmeyer, Pulman, Branscomb, Langley & Banack, Chasnoff Stribling, Kaufman & Killen, Clausewitz Reyes, Begum Pelaez-Prada, msquared, Barton Law, Graves Dougherty, Bonds Ellis, Jones Hassett, Bailey Brauer, Hallett & Perrin, McClure Law Group, Gallian Firm, Stewart Law Group and others) and only the seven firms listed here published a named partner email. Two additional legal rows (Skiermont Derby, Huggins Reddien Kornbacher, Varghese Summersett) are included on the strength of dated 2026 triggers even though they publish only a general mailbox.

Things the verifier should double-check before outreach: Silver Ventures' CEO title (sourced from an org-chart directory plus a dated public-event post, not the firm site); Dallas Neurosurgical & Spine's current president (two people are publicly listed as President); Star Orthopedics (physician co-founder vs. a separately listed non-physician CEO); ENZI Wealth (Form ADV names William Martinez as managing member/CCO while public profiles still call David Martinez founder/CEO); Alonso & Alonso's headcount (State Bar says 2-5 attorneys, a LinkedIn profile claims 419 staff); and FBFK Law at ~105 staff, which sits near the top of the size band. Mythic, Socha Capital and Happy Health are included with null phone AND null email because those companies publish neither on their own sites - they are outreach-by-LinkedIn rows, not phone rows.
